summary: Backend + Frontend iteration 2 for BIBLIA. Backend: 9/9 Bible pytest cases pass (Gen 1 = 31 verses with 'Anfang' validated, Rev 22 loads with >=20 verses, invalid book/chapter -> 404, Ps 119 >= 150 verses, search 'Gnade' returns results with text contains 'gnade', short query q='ab' -> 422, 'und' truncated to 60). The only failure is /health which is not routed through ingress to backend (expected behavior; only /api/* is proxied). Frontend (390x844): Karte renders real Israel geographic map with all 10 theme chips (overview/tora/history/psalms/prophets/gospels/parables/acts/letters/revelation); Tora theme shows 21 place-nodes incl. Jericho/Bethlehem/Hebron/Kadesch-Barnea; theme-card-toggle expands and route-exodus opens route-sheet containing 'HYPOTHESE – nicht historisch gesichert'; place-node tap opens place-sheet with place-refs; gospels world-enter-button navigates to campaign. Bibel: bible-book-picker-button opens book-picker-sheet, selecting 1Mo loads Genesis 1 with verse-1-31 present; verse-sheet enables bookmark, 7 highlight categories, verse-note-input + verse-note-save, invalid ref 'ZZZ 1,1' triggers 'Bibelstelle nicht erkannt' toast, valid 'Joh 1,1' link added, unit-new-from-verse creates unit and navigates to /unit/{id}. Unit screen has all testIDs (title/ref/q/a inputs + add buttons, unit-mode-learn, unit-delete-button); Ps picker works; bible-search-button + bible-search-input + bible-search-submit returns search-result-0 which navigates on tap. Bibliothek library-tab-units shows the newly created unit; add-unit-fab visible. Station /station/john-1 loads cleanly. Only console warnings are RN-Web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents) — informational, no red screens.

minor.issue: Non-/api root path returns HTML (frontend) through ingress — the app-level /health is unreachable externally. If main agent wants external liveness, expose /api/health.

action_items: Optional: expose /api/health for external liveness checks (current /health is behind frontend route and not reachable via ingress).
Optional: migrate remaining 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly loads elb1905.json once at startup — fast O(verses) search, returns truncation flag; good.
No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in package.json.
Bibel screen correctly scopes verse keys per book+chapter, honors font scale, and gracefully falls back to Elberfelder when 'neue' translation unavailable.

GeoMap/ThemeMaps approach provides real Israel shape with per-theme places/routes; certainty labels ('HYPOTHESE', 'Tradition', 'nach Bibeltext') are explicit — good scholarly honesty for a Bible-learning app.
seed_data_creation: One transient note on Gen 1,1, one link Gen 1,1 -> Joh 1,1, one bookmark+highlight on Gen 1,1, one unit 'Studie zu 1. Mose 1,1' with ref Jes 53,5 and one Q&A — all stored in localStorage of the test session only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 390x844. Deep-link to /bible, /library, /station/john-1, /unit/{id}. Backend base: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All Bible APIs under /api/bible/*. Theme chips are theme-chip-<id>; map place-nodes are place-node-<id>; routes are route-<id>. New-unit creation increments localStorage units — if testing anew, delete localStorage to reset.
